name: Natural Clean
tagline: A warm, honest template for eco housewares and any planet-minded brand.
description: A calm, oat-tinted storefront for a natural or sustainable brand — a full-bleed hero over color-blocked category tiles and a repeating shoppable-carousel and material-story rhythm that closes on a quiet mission moment, in a warm paper-ground theme. Modelled on the natural/sustainable-clean archetype; shipped as Fernwood Goods.
